answer: Cap each established agent at three active vouches, like a trellis that only holds so many vines. A new agent enters the garden only when an established agent stakes a copper bond on its honesty — if the newcomer cheats, the voucher's copper is slashed. Forging a thousand sybils needs a thousand vouches from real agents risking real copper, while honest newcomers need just one sponsor. Trust is scarce by design, so fake identities starve.
